summaryJa: 報告書（MISREP、発信部隊: 482ATKS）は、作戦名 INHERENT RESOLVE の空中ISR任務の記録である。機体（識別は秘匿）はOKASから011206Zに離陸し、011220Z～020426Zにオンステーションで活動、総飛行時間は19時間17分、ステーション滞在時間は18時間35分。1323Z～0626Zにエアハンドラー経由でSIGINTを収集し、主要センサーはFMV。任務中（1518Z～0426Z）にHVI/POI、POL、武器や車列等のスキャンを実施。1620ZにIVO指定地点で西→東へ移動する可能性のあるUAP/UAVを1件観測したが追跡せず任務継続、以後異常なし。0426Zに任務解除（RTB）許可、0655ZにLREへ引き渡し、0723ZにOKAS着陸。FMVはDGS-ARで解析。事前調整は236分前に実施し「満足」と評価、天候は影響なし。EEIは観測されず、インテリのギャップは埋まっていないと記載。
summaryEn: This MISREP from 482ATKS documents an air ISR mission in support of Operation INHERENT RESOLVE. The (redacted) aircraft departed OKAS at 011206Z and was on station from 011220Z to 020426Z; total mission time was 19:17 and time on station 18:35. SIGINT was collected via airhandler from 1323Z to 0626Z; primary sensor was FMV. Between 1518Z and 0426Z the asset conducted scans for HVI/POI, POL, weapons, convoys/sentry and personnel. At 1620Z one possible UAP/UAV was observed flying west to east IVO the tasked location; the platform did not pursue and continued the mission with no further events. Cleared off tasking/RTB at 0426Z, handed back to the LRE at 0655Z, and landed at OKAS at 0723Z. FMV was exploited by DGS‑AR. Precoordination occurred 236 minutes prior and was assessed satisfactory; weather was not a factor. No EEIs were observed and the report indicates no intelligence gap was filled.
